user_query: I want to read articles about climate change from various publications. Can you fetch me the climate change news from The Guardian using the Climate Change API? Additionally, I would like to search for articles about Trump and Biden. Fetch me all Trump articles and Biden articles from major newspapers such as The Guardian and The New York Times.

TaskList.description: Fetch climate change news articles from The Guardian using the Climate Change API.
Search for articles about Trump from The Guardian and The New York Times.
Search for articles about Biden from The Guardian and The New York Times.
